title: Bullets of Fury — Arcade PCM V2 Preview Bank
soundDirection: Layered late-1990s arcade shooter PCM: filtered-noise transients, body/sub layers, stereo diffusion, cabinet-style short reflections, and restrained saturation. No exposed chip-wave presets.
note: Preview-only. V1 and all Bullets of Fury game assets remain untouched.
